claims.claim_ar: طباق/مقابلة بين «عَمَلًا صَالِحًا» و«آخَرَ سَيِّئًا»؛ ترتيب العبارة يبرز التضاد والتناوب في الأعمال.
claims.claim_en: Tibaq (antithesis): the pairing of 'a good deed' (عَمَلًا صَالِحًا) with 'another evil' (آخَرَ سَيِّئًا) creates a contrast that highlights the mixture of good and bad acts.
claims.needs_review_reason: The antithesis is clear in the verse itself, but the supporting source chunk speaks generally of ‘الدقة في الترتيب’ (precision in ordering) rather than naming 'طباق' explicitly; mapping the source's remark on ordering to this specific device should be verified against a dedicated balagha commentary.

claims.claim_ar: التفات: انتقال مفاجئ من وصف حال المكذبين والمختلط أعمالهم إلى تمنٍّ ورباط رجاءي («عَسَى اللَّهُ أَنْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ»).
claims.claim_en: Iltifat (shift/turn): the verse turns suddenly from describing people who mixed good and bad deeds to an expression of hope that God may forgive them, creating a change of mood/register.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source chunk contains the term 'الالتفات' and discusses the rhetorical notion in other verse-examples; it does not explicitly analyze this ayah here, so the identification relies on applying the general concept to this verse — recommend checking a tafsir/balagha text that treats this specific verse.

claims.claim_ar: استخدام «إِنَّ» للتوكيد: افتتاح الجملة الخبرية المؤكّدة («إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ») ليقوّي تأكيد رحمة الله وغفرانه عقب ذكر أعمال الناس المختلطة.
claims.claim_en: Use of 'إِنَّ' as an emphasizing particle: the particle inaugurates a strongly affirmed clause ('Indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful'), reinforcing the Divine attribute after mentioning mixed deeds.
